gloss_en: the rainbow (keshet) — the arc seen in the clouds as the sign of God's covenant after the Flood, symbolizing the tzaddik whose merit protects the generation (Ketubot 77b; 'I will see it to remember the eternal covenant')

outliers.actual_gloss_en: the archer's bow — a weapon that shoots arrows, symbolizing the rectified covenant (tikkun ha-brit) from which the 'arrows' of prayer are shot forth
outliers.reason: Same consonants and vocalization, but a distinct sense: here keshet is the weapon that launches arrows (prayer), not the rainbow of the covenant sign seen in the sky.
